name: Add DELETE handler in handleDeployByID: look up deployment by id (404 if missing); if status is pending or building return 409 (build in progress — caller should redeploy instead of delete); if running, kill process via d.processes map (SIGTERM) or deregister the static host from DeploymentHostRegistry; delete build directory from d.buildsDir/<id>/; evict in-memory deploy logs via d.deleteDeployLogs(id); execute DELETE FROM deployments WHERE id = ?; return 204 No Content. Guard: if the deployment is the only running deploy for its repo_id, still allow deletion (the site will show "no deployment" rather than silently break).
